import addup
import workshare


def test_pm02_compositional_parallel_sum():
    parts = workshare.split_work([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], 3)
    assert parts == [[1, 4], [2, 5], [3, 6]]
    assert addup.combine([sum(p) for p in parts]) == 21
